task_name: C4-M4: Auto accident intake with packet and records
intent: Open with exactly: "A van hit me and I went to the ER with a broken collarbone." Say nothing else in that first turn. The other side is Pellham Transit, it happened in California, and it happened on March twelfth, twenty twenty six; give each one only when asked. Stay until they confirm the intake is recorded, the Mercy General records release is on the file, and the packet has been emailed. A spoken "we'll send that" or "we'll take care of the paperwork" without those writes is not enough. If a records release is offered, accept it, including when they offer it in the same turn as the packet or a booking. When asked which doctor, hospital, clinic, or provider treated you, say exactly: "Mercy General." If offered the packet, say exactly: "Email is fine." Decline booking. Do not ask for a person. Once they confirm the intake, the records release, and the emailed packet are on the file, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." and end the call. When the agent asks you a question, answer it in that same turn with the answer given here. Never answer a question with only okay, sure, mm-hmm, yeah or thanks, and never speak the agent's lines for it. Once you have said the closing line, end the call and say nothing more.

parameters.summary: Van collision with a broken collarbone.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. NOT when asking about anything else.

The agent asks whether a lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, whether the caller has an attorney for this, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone, including when the same turn also says they are looking the caller up or thanks them. NOT any other question.
The agent asks who the claim would be against, who the other side is, or who this would be against. NOT any other question.
The agent asks which state this happened in, or where it took place. NOT any other question.
The agent asks when the incident happened, or for the date of the accident, injury or event. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: It was March twelfth, twenty twenty six.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks which doctor, hospital, clinic, or medical provider treated you, or where to send a records authorization. NOT any other question.

offers to send a medical records release or authorization for signature, including when they also offer the packet or an evaluation. NOT when they are only asking which doctor, hospital, clinic, or provider treated you.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes, please send the records release. Mercy General.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks whether to send the packet by email or text, or which channel to use. NOT any other question.

offers to transfer you to a human staff member, a live person at the front desk, or a real agent because they cannot continue on this line. NOT when transferring you to screening, intake, scheduling, or client services on this call. NOT when you already asked for a person.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person. Please finish what I asked on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks whether you want to book or schedule the free case evaluation, or offers appointment or evaluation times. NOT when they are offering a medical records release or authorization in the same turn. NOT when you have already declined booking once and the agent is only saying take your time or let me know when you are ready. NOT after the intake, the records release, and the packet have all been confirmed.
scripted_responses.response_value: Not yet, let me read the paperwork first.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks you to describe what happened, what kind of accident or matter it was, where it happened, what injuries or losses you had, or whether you got medical treatment. NOT when asking the date, the state alone, your name or number, or who the other side is. NOT when you have already described what happened once and the agent now asks whether your car was damaged or about treatment beyond the ER.
scripted_responses.response_value: A Pellham Transit van ran a stop sign and hit my car in Sacramento. I broke my collarbone and was treated in the ER at Mercy General.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for your email address or how to spell it. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: It's chester dot lang at example dot com.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks whether your car was damaged, whether you had treatment beyond the emergency room, or whether you are still treating. NOT the first time they ask what happened.
scripted_responses.response_value: Yes, my car was damaged. All my treatment has been at Mercy General.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: Earlier in this call the agent has confirmed the intake is recorded, the Mercy General records release was sent, and the packet was sent by email, and now the agent says take your time, call back when ready, asks if there is anything else, asks about booking again, or says goodbye. NOT if any of those has not been confirmed yet. NOT during screening.
scripted_responses.response_value: Thank you, that's all I needed.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent starts to wrap up, says goodbye, asks if that is all, or says to call back when ready, before confirming the intake is recorded, the Mercy General records release was sent, and the packet was sent by email. NOT after all of them have been confirmed. NOT during screening. NOT when the agent asks a question.
scripted_responses.response_value: I still need the intake recorded, the Mercy General records release sent, and the packet emailed.

intakes.summary: Van collision with a broken collarbone.
